CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit


Private Sub CautB_Click()
If Nz(CAUT, "") = "" Then
    MsgBox "Ce cauti?!", vbOKOnly + vbExclamation
    Exit Sub
End If

If Nz(IDL, -1) = -1 Then
    MsgBox "Nu ai selectat luna in care doresti sa cauti!", vbOKOnly + vbCritical
    Exit Sub
End If

Dim rs As DAO.Recordset

Set rs = Me.Grupe.Form.Recordset

rs.FindFirst "IDG = " & CAUT.Column(4)

If rs.NoMatch Then MsgBox "Copilul nu a fost gasit in prezenta!" & vbCrLf & "Poate nu este adaugat la grupa lui!", vbOKOnly + vbExclamation
    
Me!Grupe!CL = CAUT.Column(4)

Call IncarcaPrezenta(True)
If Forms!prezenta!Plati.SourceObject <> "Rapoarte" Then Call AfisareInitiala

Forms!prezenta!Prezenta_sub!Calc.Enabled = True

Set rs = Me.Prezenta_sub.Form.Recordset

rs.FindFirst "IDP = " & CAUT.Column(5)

If rs.NoMatch Then
    Set rs = Nothing
    Exit Sub
End If

Me!Prezenta_sub!CL = Nz(DLookup("IDZ", "Prezenta", "IDP = " & CAUT.Column(5) & " AND IDL = " & Me!IDL), 0)

If Me!Prezenta_sub!CL <> 0 Then
    Det = "Detalii " & vbCrLf & Me!Prezenta_sub!IDP_p
    IDZ = Me!Prezenta_sub!IDZ
    IDP = Me!Prezenta_sub!IDP
    Plati.Requery
    Det_s.Requery
End If

Set rs = Nothing

End Sub

Private Sub CautT_Change()
Select Case CautT
    Case 1
        CAUT.RowSource = CautNume.RowSource
        CAUT.ColumnWidths = CautNume.ColumnWidths
    Case 2
        CAUT.RowSource = CautCNP.RowSource
        CAUT.ColumnWidths = CautCNP.ColumnWidths
End Select

CAUT.SetFocus
CAUT.Dropdown

End Sub

Private Sub Form_Load()
Implicit = False
Facturi.visible = False
Luni.Enabled = True
Luni.Form.AllowAdditions = True
Grupe.Enabled = True

CautT.Enabled = False
CautT = ""
CAUT.Enabled = False
CautB.Enabled = False

Me.InsideWidth = 12276

Call GolesteTabel(, "Prezenta_L")
Call GolesteTabel(, "Prezenta_sub_L")

Me!OUT.SetFocus
Me!Und.visible = False


Me!Luni.Enabled = True

Private Sub OUT_Click()
DoCmd.Close acForm, Me.Name

End Sub

Private Sub Plati_Enter()
Select Case Plati.SourceObject
    Case "Plati_fact"
        If Not Plati.Form.NewRecord Then
            Plati.Form!FOC.visible = True
            Plati.Form!FOC.SetFocus
        End If
        
    Case "Plati_sub"
End Select
End Sub

Private Sub Und_Click()
Forms!prezenta!CautT.Enabled = True
Forms!prezenta!CAUT.Enabled = True
Forms!prezenta!CautB.Enabled = True
Call AfisareInitiala
End Sub
